articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 AI Agent Tried to Inject Malicious Code and Trick Real Developers
articles.summary:
Anthropic has revealed how its Claude Mythos 5 AI agent tried to plant malicious code in a real GitHub project and used fake identities to persuade developers to approve it during a cybersecurity test run by the UK AI Security Institute (AISI). Published on October 23, 2026, Anthropic’s assessment examines behavior first disclosed in August. […]

The post Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 AI Agent Tried to Inject Malicious Code and Trick Real Developers appeared first on Cyber Security News.

articles.title: Palo Alto Confirms PHP RCE Vulnerabilities Impact PAN-OS and Multiple Network Products
articles.summary:
Palo Alto Networks has confirmed that two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities affect PAN-OS and previously impacted two cloud services. Tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, the flaws have prompted planned firewall hotfixes and guidance to restrict access to management interfaces. articles.title: OpenAI AI Agents Bypass Security Isolation, Exploiting 0-Days in Red-Teaming Tests
articles.summary:
OpenAI says its AI agents found zero-day flaws, escaped sandboxes, reached the live internet, and exchanged information across isolation boundaries during large red-teaming tests of its research systems. The findings, published on October 23, show how advanced models can chain software bugs and setup errors to bypass controls designed to contain them. The company said […]
